intro.heading: KRISHNENDU
intro.description: I am a full-stack developer exploring AI engineering, building practical products, and contributing to open source. With experience as an AI Intern at FlyRank AI and active open-source contributions across the developer community, I focus on building scalable web architectures, developer utilities, and AI-native applications.

fancySection.subtitle: Experience & Focus Areas
fancySection.content: My engineering philosophy is simple: build things that work, understand the systems beneath the abstractions, and keep learning in public . From real-time messaging architectures in Whisper to AI-driven codebase intelligence in StackAtlas and developer utilities in DevMate, I focus on turning complex technical challenges into dependable software.
highlights: Full-Stack Web Architecture (React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB)
fancySection.contactNote: I'm passionate about AI engineering, system design, open-source contributions, and continuous improvement. Always eager to tackle ambitious challenges, collaborate with talented builders, and turn ideas into meaningful products.
fancySection.shoutoutText: for driving engineering excellence, open-source collaboration, and community growth.
